decision: SysML 8.2.2.5.1 uses FilterPackageImport and never defines it, an omission OMG has as SYSML21-449. The definition is taken from the specification's Tier B' BNF (SysML-textual-bnf.kebnf line 172): `FilterPackageImport : Import = ImportDeclaration { visibility = 'public' }`. The action sets visibility and consumes no tokens, so syntactically this is an ImportDeclaration. The Xtext writes FilterPackageMembershipImport | FilterPackageNamespaceImport, which accepts the same tokens. Recorded as deviation FilterPackageImport.

evidence.note: FilterPackage : Package = ownedRelationship += FilterPackageImport ( ownedRelationship += FilterPackageMember )+, with FilterPackageImport undefined in the clause
follow_spec, taking Tier B''s definition in place of the missing clause text
EXACT MATCH, naming FilterPackageImport as undefined. Fetched and read on 2026-09-17.
line 28: `public import vehicle::**[@Safety];`, where `vehicle::**` is the filtered ImportDeclaration
FilterPackageImport: FilterPackageMembershipImport | FilterPackageNamespaceImport, over ImportedMembership | ImportedNamespace. The same tokens.

Defined from Tier B', not from the PDF clause, which omits it. Revisit when SYSML21-449 is resolved.
